items.name: Driftwood Rod
items.description: Your first 2 creature attachments weigh 1 less while attached. Applies to Catch and Bait.

items.name: Ironback Rod
items.description: Your heaviest attached creature weighs 2 less. Original weight decides; earliest attachment breaks ties.

items.name: Stormbent Rod
items.description: While attached weight exceeds Line Capacity, every creature Catch gains +1 sale value.

items.name: Tideglass Reel
items.description: Draw 1 additional Technique at the start of each biome, including the first.

items.name: Clockwork Reel
items.description: After a Technique and its reactions finish, draw 1 Technique if your hand is empty. Once per encounter.

items.name: Pearlwind Reel
items.description: After a new creature Bait's effect resolves, draw 1 Technique, then choose 1 Technique to discard.

items.name: Barbed Hook
items.description: Every 3rd new creature Catch gains +2 sale value until it leaves the chain. Count persists across biomes.

items.name: Living Hook
items.description: While at least 2 creature Baits are attached, all creature Baits weigh 1 less. Minimum weight 0.

items.name: Twinfang Hook
items.description: While at least 1 creature Bait is attached, every creature Catch gains +1 sale value.
